title: Doktor KosMed public-site performance baseline
scope: Production public HTML route response and Cache-Control headers
Representative Uzbek and Russian public pages measured on simulated mobile and desktop profiles
Lighthouse performance score, FCP, LCP, CLS, TBT, transferred bytes, and server-response-time opportunities

cloudflare_rum_blocking.reason: A Cloudflare Web Analytics/RUM beacon was observed in the initial probe; later measurements blocked the script and beacon to avoid additional telemetry submissions.
cloudflare_rum_blocking.control_verification: All 14 blocked measurement reports showed zero transferred bytes for the beacon script and no /cdn-cgi/rum request.

field_data.reason: The PageSpeed Insights API returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests; no field p75 metrics were retrieved.
field_data.note: Lighthouse TBT is a lab metric and is not an INP measurement. Lab samples do not establish Core Web Vitals p75 compliance.

findings.observation: Lighthouse estimated 411-1104 ms savings from reducing initial server response time across the sampled routes. This is a diagnostic opportunity, not a verified root cause or guaranteed saving.
findings.verification_needed: Inspect aggregate Vercel Function and FastAPI request timings before attributing the delay to SSR, backend, database, or network.

findings.observation: The production page loaded static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js (10478 transferred bytes) and made a request to /cdn-cgi/rum (HTTP 204). Cloudflare documents these as its Web Analytics/RUM beacon and reporting endpoint. The project plan currently excludes external RUM for the first release. No app-level reference was found in the searched frontend, Vercel, ops, and workflow paths; Cloudflare account settings were not inspected.
findings.verification_needed: Review Cloudflare Web Analytics/RUM configuration against the approved no-external-RUM policy. No Cloudflare setting was changed.

unblocked_detection_probe.note: One anonymous synthetic browser visit triggered a beacon. No patient account, patient record, or user-entered data was used. This probe is excluded from the blocked-RUM measurement summary.

core_web_vitals_targets.source: Project plan section 12.2; Google web.dev Core Web Vitals thresholds

limitations: One Lighthouse run per route and device profile; results are a directional lab snapshot and can vary between runs.

Routes sampled: Uzbek and Russian home, both localized service catalogs, Uzbek doctor/prices/contacts listings. Russian doctors/prices/contacts and individual service/doctor details were not measured.
No CrUX or other field p75 data was available.
INP was not measured; TBT must not be treated as its substitute.
Cloudflare RUM was blocked during the 14-run summary, so those transfer-size values exclude that script and endpoint.
The Lighthouse waterfall cannot separate Vercel Function, FastAPI, database, and network time; no backend or database root cause is assigned.
result: Directional Lighthouse baseline captured on production merge SHA. Performance scores were 96-100 and lab LCP 253-2185 ms across representative routes, but this is not field p75 compliance. Before optimizing, review the repeated server-response-time opportunity and resolve the observed Cloudflare RUM policy conflict.
